remarks: Welcome to "High Tide" located in Fairfield county's premiere Harborview waterfront community. This 2022 build & one-of-a-kind Modern Cape offers dramatic water views & architectural details throughout. Fema compliant, lifted above the 500 yr floodplain & elevator ready. This home was built for entertaining as the kitchen, dining rm, living rm & leisure space blend together into an oversized great room. Exposed wooden beams support the A frame cathedral ceiling w/towering windows overlooking L.I. sound & tidal inlet. Living quarters are private & separate from party space w/4 Beds & 2 1/2 Baths on 1st fl. Master ensuite incl private deck w/jacuzzi, bay views & spa w/zero entry shower for 2 w/heated flrs. The expansive upper level loft features home theater, wet bar, sitting deck overlooking the salt marsh, add'l living space for work or R&R & a full bath. Private roof deck offers incredible 360 water & city views. White oak quarter sawn floors w/ natural Bona finish throughout. Fixed & Fashioned from the ground up, this seaside gem boasts the largest garage in Harborview w/4 bays including a "toy bay" & electric car charger. Oversized driveway has space for 4 cars. Add'l 922 sq' in basement. Neighborhood amenities incl: clubhouse, playgrnd, tennis, waterfront beach, boat dock & mooring. Water sports include paddle boarding, kayaking, boating, fishing & more. Walking neighborhood, 2 miles to metro north, and SONO area. See professional drone tour on the icons above pictures
